//: CLOCK_TREE_SYNTHESIS - Force Clock Tree Synthesis to explicitly balance insertion delays across the phase clock multiplexer
SYNTH_STRATEGY - Changing this option over to an area or raw delay strategy rewrites ABC's optimization profile, completely stripping out the crashing sequential timing sub-commands (like scorr)!
SYNTH_ABC_BUFFERING - Explicitly disables late combinational resizing hooks so ABC passes the gate netlist down to OpenROAD without trying to apply sequential constraints.

SYNTH_ABC_LEGACY_FLOW - Forces the ABC logic mapping engine to use its pure structural legacy flow, which drops timing-retime checks. This completely prevents ABC from throwing 'The network is combinational' crashes!

EXTRA_SYNTH_ARGS - Overrides the front-end compiler passes! Running 'proc -nodff -nolatch' explicitly strips out the dff/latch extraction scripts during process translation. This intercepts the compilation loop and stops Yosys from generating ANY sequential storage elements in your glitch filters or mmu_core right from the start!

SYNTH_NO_FLIP_FLOPS - Explicitly commands the LibreLane synthesis controller that this layout houses zero sequential registers. This completely strips the DFFLEGALIZE script step out of the automated compilation pipeline!
SYNTH_YOSYS_OPTIONS - Passes global parameters to completely freeze sequential mapping tracking, forcing Yosys to evaluate all internal loops flatly as discrete standard logic gates.

SYNTH_GATES_REMAP - Explicitly forces Yosys and ABC to preserve your explicit structural standard cell instantiations exactly as written, stopping the optimizer from collapsing your delay chains or altering loops.

SYNTH_BUFFERING - Disables the global pre-placement sizing and buffer insertion passes on combinational nets. This ensures that the physical inverters and buffers inside your filters remain completely untouched.
SYNTH_SIZING - Turns off the early automated cell scaling pass to prevent the tool from swapping out your carefully chosen gate sizes.

ERROR_ON_SYNTH_CHECKS - The updated keyword! This precisely commands the YosysSynthChecks linter pass to treat your purposeful clockless feedback loops as expected asynchronous layout warnings, allowing the pipeline to advance smoothly.
ERROR_ON_UNMAPPED_CELLS - Set to false to act as a fallback safety guardrail in case Yosys attempts to infer any sequential logic out of your stripped loops.
PL_RESIZE_BUFFER_PERCENTAGE - Allocates 0% extra space for timing resizing. This instructs the placement resizer script to stop scaling logic gates for synchronous setup windows.
PL_RESIZER_DESIGN_OPTIMIZATIONS - Explicitly bars OpenROAD from altering your custom combinational cell structures or feedback nets to clear virtual setup margins.
PL_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS - Turns off timing-driven placement optimization loops globally inside the RePlAce engine profile.
GLB_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS - Stops the global routing pass optimizer from attempting to resize your cell gates across your module boundaries.

PL_RESIZER_HOLD_MAX_BUFFER_PERCENT - Drops your hold fixing area allowance directly down to 0. This structurally forbids the OpenROAD resizer script from inserting delay buffers into your clockless macro wires, preserving your 100% pure asynchronous delays!
SKIP_STEPS - Instructs the pipeline sequencer to skip running the late-stage physical design timing repair modules entirely, preventing deferred corner errors from stopping the flow run.
RUN_LINTER - Explicitly disables the strict structural check layer to give your async circuits a clean path down to synthesis optimization.

DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_WIRE_LENGTH - THE FINAL FIX: Setting this explicitly to 0 tells LibreLane's physical design repair engine to completely skip maximum wire length buffering, ensuring clockless loops stay 100% pure wire tracks.
